title: Signal: MD5 use via Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) (ruby) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) call in ruby code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches any Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
fpNotes: Deduplication, etag, and cache-key checksums are the common false positives; they need only a justifying comment.
